name: Tropicana Cookies Cartridge | 1g
description: This sativa strain provides the consumer with a deep and focused high. It is a cross between GSC and Tangie and together they create an infusion that includes hints of citrus followed up by a smooth cookie flavor. When in flower form, this strain has purple buds with the occasional dark green leaves dressed in orange.
